description: This Java class implements the serialization of ClientBusinessEvent objects to Avro format. It utilizes services and mappers to retrieve client data and convert it into an Avro-compatible data transfer object (DTO) for external event processing within the Fineract project.

classes.name: ClientBusinessEventSerializer
classes.description: A serializer class responsible for converting business events related to clients into Avro byte buffer serializable objects for external event processing.

methods.name: canSerialize
methods.description: Checks if the provided business event is an instance of ClientBusinessEvent, indicating if it can be serialized by this serializer.

methods.name: toAvroDTO
methods.description: Converts a BusinessEvent into its corresponding Avro DTO by retrieving the client data and mapping it to the Avro schema.

methods.name: getSupportedSchema
methods.description: Returns the class type of the Avro schema supported by this serializer, which is ClientDataV1.
